bullets_en: After Mirzapur, Panchayat: The Movie is on the cards?.
20 Pakistani personnel killed in series of attacks across Balochistan, claims BLA.

11 killed as bus collides with truck in UAE's Ras Al Khaimah.
Army regiment steps in as family at late soldier's daughter's wedding in Rajasthan.
bullets_ur: Mirzapur ke baad, kya Panchayat: The Movie banne wali hai?
20 Pakistani personnel ki maut ho gayi.
Meerut mein noujawano ko khudkash hamlon ke liye bharti karne ke ilzam mein ek shakhs giraftar.
UAE ke shehar Ras Al Khaimah mein bus aur truck ki takkar se 11 log halak.
Rajasthan mein shaheed fauji ki beti ki shadi par fauji regiment ne zimmedari utha li.
